decisions.reason: As an agency-oriented compliance add-on close to the core offer, Product A still fits the firm’s stated expansion path and, without evidence of results below aspiration, would be retained while management continues incremental learning.

Because Product B is the flagship platform tied to the firm’s strategic direction and core hosting capabilities, behavioral management would continue to support it unless performance became clearly disappointing relative to aspiration.

Product D is a close-to-core security extension that likely benefits from existing technical resources and customer needs, but its newer and less prominently evidenced market position makes it somewhat more vulnerable than A or B if uptake falls short.
